question: What effect does abstaining from food by day have on age and death?
premises: A future going beyond it is stated.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death from aging.
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is ambiguous; may mean go to or go beyond death
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will overcome death brought by age.
